subject: planner: PointGet will not skip the reuse chunk with enough total memory (#63921)
summary: Reviewed commit diff vs parent: `disableReuseChunkIfNeeded` now treats `PointGetPlan` specially by using total system/cgroup memory (`memory.MemTotal`) plus total column `Flen` (threshold ~32MB) to decide whether to clear the session chunk allocator, instead of always disabling reuse for overlong types; other readers still disable unconditionally on overlong types. Confirmed `SessionVars.SetAlloc`/`ClearAlloc` behavior and that `memory.MemTotal` respects cgroup/physical memory hooks. Added casetest (`TestDisableReuseChunk`) validates `@@last_sql_use_alloc` toggling via `core.MaxMemoryLimitForOverlongType`. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and found no subsequent changes to this logic. No remaining Blocker/High issues identified in planner correctness/semantics/session behavior.
